kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتعاضد (form VI)
# نَتَعَاضَدُ (nataʕāḍadu) /na.ta.ʕaː.dˤa.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاضَدَ (taʕāḍada)
# نَتَعَاضَدَ (nataʕāḍada) /na.ta.ʕaː.dˤa.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاضَدَ (taʕāḍada)
# نَتَعَاضَدْ (nataʕāḍad) /na.ta.ʕaː.dˤad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَاضَدَ (taʕāḍada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
